Name: One-Day Robin Construction
Author: EleanorWilde
Description:
ONE-DAY ROBIN CONSTRUCTION — PUBLIC BETA

New farm buildings and upgrades handled by Robin take one in-game day instead of several. Farmhouse upgrades also take one day, and a pending farmhouse upgrade is shortened on save load. Projects that were already instant stay instant. Costs, material requirements, and prerequisites are unchanged. This mod does not change Clint’s tool upgrades or promise to speed up already-started farm building projects.

Installation: Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer, unzip into the game’s Mods folder, and launch through SMAPI.

Testing: Built for Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Windows. Live gameplay and multiplayer have not been verified. If you encounter a problem, include the project type and your SMAPI log.

罗宾施工一天｜公开测试版
罗宾负责的新农场建筑、建筑升级与农舍升级，原本超过一天的工期均改为一个游戏日。即时完工的项目仍然即时完成，价格、材料和解锁条件不变。读档会缩短尚未完成的农舍升级，其他已经开工的建筑不保证受影响。不影响克林特的工具升级。

安装：安装 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更新版本，将 ZIP 解压至 Mods 文件夹，通过 SMAPI 启动。版本针对 Windows 的星露谷物语 1.6.15，尚未进游戏或联机实测。

AI disclosure / AI 说明: Codex generated most of the C# code and helped create the listing and illustrated GIF. The GIF is not gameplay footage. 主要代码由 Codex 生成；动图是示意，并非游戏实录。
